purpose: Bounded, reviewer-motivated Fisher-response sensitivity and calibration after the Stage 12 boundary winner at lambda=2. This is not an untouched confirmatory dataset or proof of Fisher curvature accuracy.
invariants: Same 200-step full AdamW recursion, unscaled deletion sources, L8/L4M4 requests, Development/Dev-Select partition, utility guards and equal-scenario mean E_U objective. No FinalTest access, new baselines or historical replacement.

coarse.controls: Rerun 1 and 2; require both to match frozen Stage 12 E_U/D_U/AUC/logloss within max(1e-8,0.001*abs(old)), and require the inherited formal-adapter gate at 1. Rerun controls are never duplicate selection candidates.
coarse.selection: Both requests must pass AUC damage<=0.005, logloss damage<=0.01 and no prediction collapse. Minimize equal-scenario mean E_U, ties nearest 1 then candidate ID.

budget_gate.reference: Frozen seed-42 Stage 12 lambda=2 equal-scenario mean E_U
budget_gate.rule: Both thresholds must pass. This is an engineering continuation threshold, not a statistical-significance or scientific-materiality claim.

fine.trigger: Coarse winner is 4 or 8 and passes the budget gate.
fine.grid_rule: Exactly the two arithmetic midpoints to its adjacent coarse grid values: winner 4 -> [3,6], winner 8 -> [6,12]. Freeze this decision before running fine candidates. Neighboring utility/numerical failures remain reported; an interior feasible winner is not proof of a smooth turning point.

final_selection: Merge seven frozen Stage 12 candidates with new 4/8/16 and at most two fine candidates. Preserve all rows, including failures. Same utility/tie rules. Freeze final selection before cross-seed confirmation.
stopping: No lambda above 16; if 16 wins, flag an unresolved boundary optimum. No automatic expansion.
No fine scan for a boundary winner, lambda=2 winner, or a gain below the budget gate.
If final winner adds no budget-gate-passing benefit over 2, do not run new cross-seed confirmation; keep Stage 12 as the existing reference while reporting the raw screen winner.
At most one fine round; do not move its interval after seeing its results.

confirmation.grid: Frozen final winner plus controls 1 and 2, once per seed/request.
confirmation.pass: All winner cells utility-eligible and non-collapsed with residual<1. Both controls eligible. Mean E_U strictly below each control separately in each seed. Report all cell regressions and absolute/relative gains; no reselection from confirmation data.
confirmation.interpretation: Previously evaluated Development seeds, not independent untouched holdouts. No automatic FinalTest authorization.

failures: Known numerical failures invalidate and retain the candidate. Failure of either reproduction control, OOM, software, IO or integrity errors abort that cell; preserve incomplete diagnostics. No clipping, silent dropping, rescue tuning or overwrites.
diagnostics: Report per-request parameter-update norm, cosine and relative L2 to Exact-Masked at the final endpoint; descriptive only, never selection inputs or privacy guarantees.
